crime_highlights: The appellant pleaded guilty to sexual assault involving five separate incidents
The learned trial judge sentenced the appellant to five years imprisonment.
rationale_highlights: failing to consider his aboriginal background
the judge weighed and considered the appellant's aboriginal ancestry as well as the appalling circumstances of his early life
note: Appeal court only says judge considered aboriginal ancestry; effect on sentence not stated.

crime_highlights: I would describe his activities as persistent street trafficking in reasonably significant amounts for that class of trafficking.
rationale_highlights: had a troubled early history when he was subject to abuse
He is of aboriginal background and that fact was taken into account by the learned trial judge
note: Brief; court says aboriginal background considered but not its effect.

crime_highlights: The child was determined to have died from pneumonia brought on by the aspiration of vomit.
An internal injury found to exist was consistent with a very severe blow to the abdomen.
it appeared that he was, prior to his death, in a state of dehydration and starvation
rationale_highlights: the learned sentencing judge failed to give sufficient weight to the systemic background factors that led to these offenders appearing before the court on the charges that they faced
Both of the appellants came from backgrounds that were gravely disadvantaged
I consider the sentences imposed were too high
